newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices generally steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices generally steady.

text.p: Cash millfeed prices showed mixed trends on Tuesday with the market appearing to be well balanced, dealers said.
"Supplies are thin but there is no demand so there is a kind of balance," one Texas dealer said.
One dealer based in the Northeast said buying interest normally slowed in late January and February, and the trend was particularly marked this year because of competition from other feeds.
Prices in Kansas City and Minneapolis were up slightly as recent weakness sparked a modest pickup in demand.
Prices in Kansas City were about $1.00 higher, with bids around at $95.00 and offers at $97.00.
